name: Phương
body: Wore them to a wedding and then to work on Monday. The crystals catch every light and none have come loose.

name: Thảo
body: Narrow like every Samba. I went up a third and it is right. Came in two days, box perfect.

name: Vy
body: Beautiful pair. A little stiff for the first week, then fine.

name: Thu Hà
body: Bought them as a birthday gift for my sister. She has not taken them off. Express arrived next morning.

name: Hạnh
body: The beading looks expensive in person. Easy to wipe after a rainy day.

name: Quyên
body: Lovely, but tight at the toe. Exchanged for 37 1/3 with no fuss.

name: Minh Anh
body: The pink is softer than in photos, which I prefer. Paid cash at the door, checked the box first.

name: Mai Linh
body: Ordered two pairs, one for me and one for my mother. Both fit with the size chart.

name: Nhi
body: Slightly roomy at the heel; a thicker sock solves it. Gum sole is great.

name: Trang
body: More comfortable than my Sambas, softer collar. The rhinestones are subtle in daylight.

name: Yến
body: Gorgeous colour. Took four days to Cần Thơ, a day longer than promised.

name: Loan
body: Exactly the pair in the photos, with the receipt and the box. Will buy here again.

name: Quang
body: The suede is thick and the colour is even better in the sun. Paid with MoMo in a minute.

name: Tuấn
body: Hard to find in Vietnam. Genuine, double tongue and all.

name: Hiếu
body: A touch wide; I could have taken 42. Still my favourite pair.

name: Đức
body: Ran a half marathon in them. Very light, snug fit, go up a third.

name: Sơn
body: Fast shoe, thin upper. Not for rainy days.

name: Vinh
body: Ordered at night, delivered in Hà Nội the next afternoon.

name: Bảo
body: My daily runner now. Soft but not mushy, and the charcoal hides dust.

name: Thắng
body: I stand all day at work and my feet stopped hurting.

name: Lâm
body: Great shoe; the laces are a little short.

name: Khánh
body: Everyone asks about them. Comfortable for a shoe this loud.

name: Phát
body: Heavier than it looks. Packaging was excellent.

name: Duy
body: Real pair, real receipt. The shop answered my size question within the hour.

name: Long
body: Arrived the morning after I ordered. The sole is a sculpture.

name: Nhật
body: Not for everyone, which is the point. Fits like my other adidas.

name: Toàn
body: A little long; I added an insole. Colour is exactly as shown.

name: Ngọc
body: My daughter's first adidas. I measured her foot with the chart and the size was right.

name: Hiền
body: Sturdy and easy to clean after school.

name: Tâm
body: Runs a little small, like the adult Samba. Exchange was free.

name: Hương
body: Matching pair with mine. My son is very proud.

name: Thủy
body: White stays white with a damp cloth. Good value for a genuine pair.

name: Kiên
body: Took a week to soften, now worn every day.
